I have all the audit data I need. Let me produce the report directly.

# Ustoz vs Loom — Convenience Parity Report

Scope: every Loom "convenience" a typical user expects, mapped to our **code-grounded** status. Status is taken straight from the audit — no inflation. Where the audit said partial/planned, it stays that way even if the building blocks exist.

Legend: ✅ have · 🟡 partial · 🔵 planned · ❌ missing

---

## 1. Parity Matrix (by area)

### A. Recording & capture
| Loom convenience | Status | Evidence / note |
|---|---|---|
| Web screen recorder | ✅ | Full `web-recorder-dialog` + `useWebRecorder`, all phases wired |
| Browser/desktop extension recording | ✅ | `browser-extension` offscreen recorder + service worker, 3 capture modes |
| Screen + camera (PiP overlay) | ✅ | `CameraPreviewWindow` floats camera over fullscreen capture (not a true compositor, but functional) |
| Microphone audio | ✅ | `MicrophoneSelector` + device picker, switchable pre-record |
| System audio capture | ✅ | `SystemAudioToggle`; depends on browser/OS support |
| Pause & resume | ✅ | `pauseRecording`/`resumeRecording` in web + extension; timer pauses too |
| **Countdown timer before record** | 🟡 | Only in the extension auto-Meet flow; **none for manual web or popup recording** |
| Start over / retake | ✅ | `restartRecording` + RotateCcw button discards and restarts |
| Max recording length | ✅ | Free plan hard-capped 5 min auto-stop; not user-configurable |
| **Resolution / quality picker** | ❌ | Hardcoded 720p max; no UI to choose 1080p |
| Instant/background chunked upload | ✅ | `InstantRecordingUploader` S3 multipart every 1s + IndexedDB crash spool |

### B. Share & watch (viewer experience)
| Loom convenience | Status | Evidence / note |
|---|---|---|
| Instant share link on record | ✅ | Short link created at record start, shareable before upload ends |
| Public watch page, no account | ✅ | `/s/[videoId]` public policy; login not required |
| Player — seek | ✅ | Skip controls + scrubbing in custom media-player |
| Player — playback speed | ✅ | Speed dial + configurable org/video default |
| **Player — quality selector** | ❌ | HLS playback but no manual quality switch exposed |
| Password protection | ✅ | Per-video + inherited space/org passwords |
| Visibility / privacy controls | ✅ | Public / space-or-org-restricted / private (no explicit "org-only" radio) |
| Custom domain for links | ✅ | DNS-verified, Pro-gated |
| Embed / iframe | ✅ | Embed tab + `/embed/[videoId]` player |
| **oEmbed endpoint** | ❌ | We consume Loom's oEmbed but expose none of our own |
| **CTA overlay on video** | ❌ | No end-screen call-to-action button |
| Link ready before upload finishes | ✅ | "Preparing your recording" auto-refresh screen |

### C. Transcript & AI
| Loom convenience | Status | Evidence / note |
|---|---|---|
| Automatic transcription | ✅ | Gemini workflow → VTT in S3, status polled |
| **Multiple transcription languages** | 🟡 | Transcription prompt is **Uzbek-only by design**; no configurable language. Russian kept in Cyrillic |
| **Translation / dubbing** | 🟡 | Transcript-text translation to 25 langs ✅; **no audio/voice dubbing** |
| AI auto-title | ✅ | Generated, auto-applied, respects manual edits |
| AI summary | ✅ | Overview + topics, chunked for long videos, language-configurable |
| Auto chapters | ✅ | startSec + title + body, clamped + deduped |
| Action items / tasks | ✅ | tasks[] with priority + assignee + nextSteps[] |
| **Filler-word & silence removal** | 🟡 | Cleaned in **transcript text only**; no audio/video cut. Replicate audio-enhance is dead code |
| **Edit-by-transcript (cut video via text)** | ❌ | `edit-transcript` action only rewrites VTT, wired to no UI; editing is timeline-only |
| AI chat / RAG over transcript | ✅ | Embeddings + retrieveTopK + streaming SSE, rate-limited |
| Refined transcript output | ✅ (beat) | Loom lacks this; fork-specific paragraph restructuring |

### D. Comments, reactions, notifications
| Loom convenience | Status | Evidence / note |
|---|---|---|
| Timestamped comments | ✅ | Float timestamp + timeline markers + seekable badge |
| Threaded replies | ✅ | parentCommentId, 2-level thread (reply needs login) |
| Emoji reactions | ✅ | 6 fixed emojis as timestamped comments |
| **Anonymous viewer commenting** | ❌ | Server action + UI both require auth; guests get sign-in modal |
| View notifications (incl. anon) | ✅ | view + anon_view with dedup, rate-limit, geo location |
| Comment / reply notifications | ✅ | comment/reply/reaction types, email throttled 15 min |
| Notification preferences | ✅ | 5 per-type toggles checked server-side |

### E. Library, dashboard, analytics
| Loom convenience | Status | Evidence / note |
|---|---|---|
| Dashboard recordings list | ✅ | Per-org paginated grid (15/page) |
| Folders | ✅ | Nested, color-coded, can be public collections |
| Spaces (team channels) | ✅ | Members + roles + privacy + folders |
| **Search across recordings** | 🟡 have* | Wired, but **name-only LIKE**, 8 results — no full-text/semantic |
| Playlists / collections | ✅ | Public folders/spaces + `/c/[id]` pages (no separate playlist entity) |
| Analytics — view count | ✅ | uniq(session_id) via Tinybird |
| Analytics — unique viewers | ✅ | Unique anon sessions, no PII |
| **Analytics — watch engagement / completion / heatmap** | ❌ | Only page-hit/geo/device; no watch-time, completion, or heatmap |
| Thumbnails / previews | ✅ | Server-generated in upload pipeline |
| Sharing within org | ✅ | sharedVideos + spaceVideos |

\*Audit marks search "have", but functionally it is shallow (name-only) vs Loom's content search — flagged as a felt gap below.

### F. Export, integrations, account/org
| Loom convenience | Status | Evidence / note |
|---|---|---|
| Download MP4 (single) | ✅ | Signed S3 URL, owner-only |
| **Bulk / ZIP export (anti-lock-in)** | ❌ | No batch/ZIP route at all |
| **Transcript file download** | 🟡 | `formatTranscriptAsVTT()` exists; **no wired button/endpoint** |
| **Slack integration** | ❌ | Marketing copy only |
| **Jira integration** | ❌ | Marketing copy only |
| **Confluence integration** | ❌ | Marketing copy only |
| Telegram integration (our twist) | ❌🔵 | Not built; planned differentiator |
| **SSO / SAML** | 🟡 | WorkOS dep + schema columns, but action throws "not configured"; enterprise-gated |
| Teams / Organizations | ✅ | Full roles + permissions matrix |
| Member invites (email) | ✅ | Email + link + resend + remove |
| Billing / Plans (Stripe) | ✅ | Pro via Stripe; Enterprise = talk-to-sales |
| BYO-S3 storage | ✅ (beat) | Loom lacks; user + org level, any S3-compatible |
| Google Drive storage | ✅ (beat) | Loom lacks; OAuth flow, Pro |
| Self-hosting | ✅ (beat) | Loom lacks; docs + S3-compatible |
| Custom domain | ✅ | DNS-verified, Pro |
| Loom import (migration) | ✅ (beat) | Single + bulk CSV up to 500 |

---

## 2. Loom conveniences we are MISSING (ranked by how much a Loom user expects them)

Ranked by how loudly a typical Loom user would notice the absence:

1. **Manual countdown timer (🟡)** — Loom always counts "3-2-1" before any record. We only do it for auto-Meet. A returning Loom user will feel the missing beat on their very first manual recording. *Cheap to add — the extension already has the logic.*
2. **Edit-by-transcript / filler-word removal as real cuts (❌/🟡)** — Loom's headline editing convenience is "delete the text → the video cuts, ums removed." We clean text only; the action exists but is wired to nothing. High visibility, medium effort.
3. **Transcript file download (🟡)** — One-click "Download transcript (VTT/TXT)" is a baseline expectation; the formatter exists but no button. Trivial to finish, disproportionately noticed.
4. **Watch engagement / completion analytics (❌)** — Loom users live on "who watched, how far." We show view counts but not watch-time/completion/heatmap. Expected by team/sales users.
5. **Resolution choice — record 1080p + viewer quality selector (❌)** — Loom offers HD. We hardcode 720p and expose no viewer quality switch. Quality-conscious users notice immediately.
6. **Bulk / ZIP export (❌)** — Anti-lock-in expectation; absence stings on offboarding/backup, not daily use, so mid-rank.
7. **Anonymous viewer commenting (❌)** — Loom lets external viewers react/comment without an account. Our auth wall blocks a common external-feedback flow.
8. **CTA overlay on video (❌)** — Loom's sales/marketing crowd relies on end-screen CTAs. Niche but expected by that segment.
9. **Slack / Jira / Confluence integrations (❌)** — Loom's workplace stickiness. Big for teams; many solo users never touch them → ranked lower for "typical" user.
10. **oEmbed provider endpoint (❌)** — Mostly invisible (paste-into-Notion auto-embeds). Power/integrator users only.
11. **Content/semantic search (🟡)** — We have name-only search; Loom searches inside transcripts. Felt once the library grows.
12. **Live SSO/SAML (🟡)** — Enterprise gate only; irrelevant to the typical user, blocking only for enterprise buyers.

---

## 3. Where we already BEAT Loom (or will)

- **AI chat / RAG over the transcript (✅)** — ask the video questions, get cited answers. Loom has none.
- **uz/ru transcript + 25-language translation (✅)** — Uzbek-first transcription + on-page translation. Loom's localization is far weaker for this market.
- **Refined transcript output (✅)** — filler-cleaned, paragraph-restructured readable transcript; Loom does not offer this.
- **Self-host + BYO-S3 + Google Drive storage (✅)** — full data ownership and storage choice; Loom is closed SaaS only.
- **Custom domain + Loom import (✅)** — frictionless migration onto your own domain; Loom obviously won't help you leave it.
- **Viewer-free public watch (✅)** — no account to watch (parity, but combined with self-host it removes Loom's seat/viewer friction).
- **Telegram integration (🔵 planned)** — the intended differentiator; not built yet, so it's a promise, not a win, today.

---

## 4. Honest verdict

**Are we covering "all of Loom's conveniences"? No — but we're close on the core loop.** The record → instant link → watch → transcript → AI → comment → analytics → org/billing spine is genuinely present and verified. We **beat** Loom on AI chat, translation, refined transcript, and self-host/storage ownership.

The gaps are real and a Loom user **will** notice them — but most are small finishing touches, not missing pillars. The expensive-looking one (edit-by-transcript) is half-built already.

**Minimum set to make a Loom user feel at-home (in priority order):**
1. **Manual countdown timer** for web + extension popup (reuse existing logic). *Smallest effort, first-impression win.*
2. **Transcript download button** wiring `formatTranscriptAsVTT()` to a UI action + endpoint. *Near-free.*
3. **Real edit-by-transcript** — connect the existing `edit-transcript` action to timeline cuts + filler removal. *Highest-visibility editing convenience.*
4. **Watch engagement analytics** — emit play/seek/duration events to Tinybird and surface completion + heatmap.
5. **Record at 1080p + viewer quality selector** — unhardcode resolution.

Items 1-3 are days, not weeks, and close ~80% of the "this feels less polished than Loom" perception. Bulk export, anonymous commenting, CTA overlays, and the Slack/Jira/Confluence trio are second-wave — important for specific segments (offboarding, external feedback, sales, enterprise teams) but not blocking for the typical Loom switcher.
